newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australis on S&P creditwatch positive.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australis on S&P creditwatch positive.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Monday that it placed the CCC-plus corporate credit rating of pay television group Australis Ltd on creditwatch positive following the announcement of merger plans between Australis and rival pay-tv group Foxtel.
Foxtel is equally owned by News Corp Ltd and state-owned telecommunication group Telstra Corp.

The ratings agency said the creditwatch tag with positive implications also applied to CCC-plus rating on the US$150 million senior unsecured discounted notes issued by Australis and the CCC-minus rating applied to the US$175 million subordinated notes.
"Resolution of the creditwatch primarily will depend on approval to the proposed merger," it said.

The third key industry player, Optus Vision, is expected to launch a legal challenge against the merger which also needs the approval of the anti-monopolies body, the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
